notes.title: Perception: Heart and Mind Demo Release
notes.notes: [p]I am very pleased to present my game page on Steam, where you can download its Demo for Windows, Mac and Linux. Steam Deck is supported and the use of a controller is recommended. It won't be long before the full version of the game comes out. English and Greek subtitles are available. I hope you find something different in this game, this was one of my goals while developing it. In case you like the demo, Wishlists and Reviews will be very helpful! [/p]
